papers.what_it_is: A Photonics Research preprint (arXiv 2210.17286) demonstrating an active near-infrared 3D camera that uses pulsed sum-frequency upconversion in a PPLN crystal with time gating and an EMCCD, tested through scattering media and added noise.
papers.why_not: The paper reports a classical optical imaging apparatus (sum-frequency upconversion, EMCCD, time-of-flight gating). It has no quantum computing, quantum machine learning, machine learning, finance or statistics-method content, so none of the five contexts applies. Quantum parametric mode sorting is only cited as prior work.
